WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as total_units
  FROM Order_Items 
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY product_id
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_units) as gt FROM product_units
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pu.product_id,
    pu.total_units,
    pu.total_units / gt.gt as share
  FROM product_units pu, grand_total gt
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.product_id,
    ws.total_units,
    ws.share,
    asv.avg_share
  FROM with_shares ws, avg_share_val asv
  WHERE ws.share > asv.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_units) as combined_units,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
